options: about
along
during
on
solution:

☛ As a preposition, "during" correctly fits in a time-related context, such as "alcohol use during pregnancy".
☛ Other options like "about" (regarding), "along" (together), or "on" (upon) are irrelevant here as they don’t convey the temporal relationship.
☛ The sentence shows a cause-effect relationship: "alcohol use during pregnancy" leads to "birth defects." "During" clarifies this logical connection.
☛ Grammar Rule: Prepositions like "during" are vital to specify when an action occurs, especially in scientific/medical contexts (e.g., warnings or studies).

The fact that the wetter periods in North Africa have _______1_______ every 21,000 years or so is a big clue about what ________2_________ them: variations in Earth’s orbit. Due to gravitational influences from the moon and other planets in our solar system, the orbit of the Earth _________3___________ the sun is not constant. It has cyclic ______4_______ on multi-thousand year timescales. These orbital cycles _______5_______ the amount of energy the Earth receives from the sun. On 100,000-year cycles, the shape of Earth’s orbit shifts between circular and oval.

 

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
options_hi: direct
straight
around
precise
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है "around"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ "around" सही उत्तर है क्योंकि यह पृथ्वी की सूर्य के चारों ओर परिक्रमा (orbit) को दर्शाता है।
☛ "The orbit of the Earth around the sun" एक सही और प्राकृतिक वाक्य संरचना है, जो गति और दिशा को स्पष्ट करती है।
☛ "Direct", "straight", या "precise" जैसे विकल्प यहाँ अर्थहीन हैं क्योंकि वे किसी स्थिति या गुणवत्ता को दर्शाते हैं, न कि गति को।
☛ Preposition के रूप में "around" का प्रयोग circular motion (गोलाकार गति) को व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त है।

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
options: monotonies
variations
consistencies
regularities
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "variations"

Explanation:
☛ The correct answer is variations because it fits the context and grammatical structure of the sentence.
☛ The sentence states "It has cyclic ______4_______ on multi-thousand year timescales.", where the word cyclic is used. This word pairs well with variations, as cyclic variations are common in natural phenomena.
☛ Monotonies and consistencies are incorrect because they convey meanings opposite to cyclic changes.
☛ Regularities is also incorrect because the context here is about changes, not regularity.
☛ Thus, variations is the most appropriate choice, accurately describing the changes in Earth's orbit.

☛ Monotonies (एकरसता) और consistencies (सुसंगतता) गलत हैं क्योंकि ये शब्द चक्रीय परिवर्तन के विपरीत अर्थ देते हैं।
☛ Regularities (नियमितता) भी गलत है क्योंकि यहाँ परिवर्तनों की बात हो रही है, न कि नियमितता की।
☛ अतः, variations ही सही विकल्प है जो पृथ्वी की कक्षा में होने वाले बदलावों को सटीक रूप से दर्शाता है।

stretch
return
influence
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "influence"

Explanation:
☛ The correct answer is "influence" because it is a verb that logically connects "orbital cycles" and "the amount of energy" in a cause-effect relationship.
☛ The sentence structure "These orbital cycles _______ the amount of energy..." requires an action verb to show impact.
☛ "Believe" and "return" are contextually incorrect as they don’t convey this relationship. "Stretch" is irrelevant as it implies physical extension, not effect.
☛ Grammar rule: Subject (orbital cycles) + Verb (influence) + Object (energy) is grammatically accurate.
